messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH - hosted-inference-us-west latency spike on pool inference-hosted-01. Primary oncall @devon paged. https://pagerduty.example/INC-5182 :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-5182 created; escalation policy 'Inference Oncall' will run. primary: devon, secondary: sarah, manager: liam-manager. Auto-escalation in 120s if unacked.
devon: acked. jumping on this now, grabbing metrics + tailing logs.
devon: quick note — mobile was a bit slow to notify me, but I have the page. starting checks: pod health, qps, GPU temp.
sarah: saw the escalation come through, i'm available if it flips to me. ping me here if you want me to join the bridge.
devon: seeing continuous 95th latency ~ 1.8s (baseline ~ 120ms) for gen endpoints. errors also up ~ 3% 500s from model host pool.
devon: running `kubectl get pods -n inference -l pool=hosted-01 -o wide` to see node distribution.
devon: ```
NAME                                      READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE   NODE
inference-hosted-01-pod-7b9c8             1/1     Running   0          9d   gpu-usw2-03
inference-hosted-01-pod-8f1d2             0/1     CrashLoop 6          3h   gpu-usw2-02
```
devon: one pod is crashlooping, likely causing KV cache warmup storms and increasing tail latency. digging logs now.
tess: tagging infra, routing, and runtime. ops-bridge creating a temporary bridge.
ops-bridge: created bridge: https://zoom.example/j/88431121 bridge id 88431121. joining.
sarah: PD just escalated — I got a page saying devon didn't ack fast enough earlier (maybe before they acked) and manager liam-manager was notified. I haven't acked because I thought devon had it.
liam-manager: got the manager page. standing by, happy to join if we need incident lead.
devon: logs show repeated OOMs on the crashlooping pod, looks like a quantized kernel blew memory. sample log:
```
[2026-03-15T03:52:12Z] runtime_error: cuda out of memory while allocating 1.2G
stack: ...kernel-launch...
```
devon: mitigation plan: 1) cordon the bad node to prevent more pod restarts, 2) scale up warm standby pool (hosted-01-warm) by +2 replicas, 3) route traffic away from affected pods via service patch.
sarah: agree. I'll take step 3 (service patch) if devon does cordon+scale.
devon: cordoned node gpu-usw2-02: `kubectl cordon gpu-usw2-02` done. scaling warm pool: `kubectl scale deployment hosted-01-warm --replicas=5` in progress.
devon: patching service to remove crashlooping pod endpoints.
ops-bridge: hostpool scale reported success; new pods starting on gpu-usw2-04 and gpu-usw2-05.
devon: after reroute, 95th latency dropped to ~250ms, errors down to 0.4%. looks like mitigation is working. updating PagerDuty.
pagerduty-bot: INC-5182 status: acknowledged by devon. note: initial auto-escalation fired and sent pages to sarah and liam-manager due to race; resolved acknowledgment now present.
sarah: thanks — good catch on the OOM. did we identify root cause? kernel regression from recent runtime bump?
devon: preliminary -- yes, a kernel change in the quantized executor from yesterday's runtime release looks correlated. filing a follow-up with eng-runtime.
liam-manager: two quick operational asks: 1) create internal postmortem ticket, 2) check PD escalation window (120s) — we had a race where devon did ack but PD still escalated. can we reduce false manager pages?
tess: noted. opening INC-5182-triage in internal tracker and assigning to devon + eng-runtime + oncall doc owners.
devon: created PROD-7764 (link: https://issues.example/PROD-7764) — title: 'OOM on hosted-01 after runtime v2.4.1 kernel change'. description + logs attached.
sarah: quick customer impact summary for comms: affected hosted inference requests in us-west for ~12 minutes. peak error rate 3%, average extra latency ~1.6s on 95th for that window. no data leakage, no auth failures. one enterprise customer (acme-corp) reported intermittent failures; their requests were rerouted after mitigation.
liam-manager: good. let's avoid manager escalation noise: suggest we change policy to 180s for manager step or require secondary ack before manager page. I'll schedule a PD policy review.
devon: agree on policy change. also adding a runbook step to watch for OOM signature and preemptively scale warm pool.
tess: action items: ["PROD-7764 created by devon","PD policy review — liam-manager","runtime regression rollback plan — eng-runtime","follow-up postmortem doc — devon, sarah"]
ops-bridge: closing Zoom bridge in 10m unless objections.
devon: no objections. final note: root cause suspected kernel regression; mitigation was successful; will follow up with rollback or patch.
sarah: thanks everyone. marking incident as resolved in PS once postmortem is up. :white_check_mark:
